Ministry of Labour- Industrial Dispute between L.W. Chandraratne and Sri Lanka Transport Board
Industrial Dispute between D.M.S. Gunaratne and National Lotteries Board
categorisation: This gazette content involves orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, which constitutes legal/regulatory matters. It contains statutory instruments appointing arbitrators to settle industrial disputes between individuals and government entities, falling under legal notices and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
